svg.title: Achievements unlocked
svg.desc: Six spells mastered, each with a 3D icon: Ship It ×30 — 30+ games and prototypes built and shipped on GitHub.; Live on the Web — 25+ games playable right now — no install, just a link.; Unity → Web — Unity games transmuted into lightweight, dependency-free HTML5.; Shape Shifter — Made polygons, triangles and parallelograms fun to learn.; Story Mode — Voiced, character-led lessons with Popo, Momo, Swiftee & Kabir.; Figma → Code — From Figma frame to live game — design and code, end to end.

g.text: From Figma frame to live game —
design and code, end to end.
